turns.content: Hello, I'm your doctor today. What brings you in today?

I’m here because I have expiratory wheezing, and I’ve also been having significant shortness of breath and a cough. I’ve had 2 or more asthma attacks in the past year, and I was hospitalized for an asthma attack in the past year. I also had a cold in the last 2 weeks, and I’ve been diagnosed with chronic sinusitis. I’m exposed to secondhand cigarette smoke daily.
[ASK] Do you have **sudden shortness of breath (especially at rest) with sharp chest pain that may worsen when breathing in**?
[ASK] Do you have sudden, sharp chest pain that is worse when you take a deep breath (pleuritic pain) or sudden shortness of breath?
[DDX] Acute pulmonary edema  , Possible NSTEMI / STEMI
